name: Ways to revoke consent, free of cost (Schedule-II)

attrs.quote: to provide modes, free of cost, to the customer, as per his choice, to revoke consent
attrs.note: SMS to 1909 with Revoke and the Sender ID, or to the number in the message or call; a call to 1909 or that number; customer care; IVRS; an approved app; a web portal with OTP. Window: the regulation 8 date, as Schedule-II states none.
